m01_route.name: route
m01_route.feedback: Use an inclusive boundary; do not return the priority itself.

m01_partition_role.name: partition_role
m01_partition_role.contract: Return fit, choose or evaluate for train, validation or test.
m01_partition_role.feedback: The final test must not choose a model.

m01_error_counts.name: error_counts
m01_error_counts.contract: Return [false_alerts, misses] for equally sized boolean lists.
m01_error_counts.solution: return [sum((not a) and p for a,p in zip(actual,predicted)), sum(a and not p for a,p in zip(actual,predicted))]
m01_error_counts.feedback: Count errors by their consequences, not only total accuracy.

m02_status_counts.name: status_counts
m02_status_counts.contract: Return a dictionary counting the status string in each record.
m02_status_counts.feedback: Initialize unseen statuses and handle an empty file.

m02_observed_mean.name: observed_mean
m02_observed_mean.contract: Return the mean excluding None; return None if no values are observed.
m02_observed_mean.solution:
observed = [x for x in values if x is not None]
return sum(observed)/len(observed) if observed else None
m02_observed_mean.feedback: Missing is not zero; zero is still observed.

m02_output_path.name: output_path
m02_output_path.contract: Return the string path root/runs/run_name/summary.json using pathlib.
m02_output_path.feedback: Join root, runs, the run name and summary.json; keep outputs separate from source files.

m03_parse_latency.name: parse_latency
m03_parse_latency.contract: Parse blank/None as None; otherwise return a nonnegative float, raising ValueError for negatives.
m03_parse_latency.feedback: Preserve measured zero and missingness separately.

m03_deduplicate.name: deduplicate
m03_deduplicate.contract: Keep the first record for each event_id, preserving input order.
m03_deduplicate.solution:
seen = set()
kept = []
for row in records:
    if row["event_id"] not in seen:
        kept.append(row)
        seen.add(row["event_id"])
return kept
m03_deduplicate.feedback: Deduplicate by identity, not the entire row.

m03_reconcile.name: reconcile
m03_reconcile.contract: Return True exactly when nonnegative counts reconcile.
m03_reconcile.solution: return all(x >= 0 for x in [input_rows,accepted,rejected,duplicates]) and input_rows == accepted+rejected+duplicates
m03_reconcile.feedback: Every source row needs one accounted-for outcome.

m04_error_rate.name: error_rate
m04_error_rate.contract: Return errors/requests; None when requests is zero.
m04_error_rate.solution: return errors/requests if requests else None
m04_error_rate.feedback: A zero denominator is unavailable, not zero percent.

m04_median.name: median
m04_median.contract: Return the median of a nonempty numerical list, without changing the input.
m04_median.solution:
ordered = sorted(values)
n = len(ordered)
return ordered[n//2] if n%2 else (ordered[n//2-1]+ordered[n//2])/2
m04_median.feedback: Average the two middle observations for an even count.

m04_weighted_rate.name: weighted_rate
m04_weighted_rate.contract: Input pairs [errors, requests]. Return total errors / total requests, or None.
m04_weighted_rate.solution:
denominator = sum(row[1] for row in counts)
return sum(row[0] for row in counts)/denominator if denominator else None
m04_weighted_rate.feedback: Do not average daily percentages with unequal denominators.

m07_squared_distance.name: squared_distance
m07_squared_distance.contract: Return sum of squared coordinate differences for equal-length vectors.
m07_squared_distance.solution: return sum((a-b)**2 for a,b in zip(point,center))
m07_squared_distance.feedback: Square coordinate differences; do not compare signed sums.

m07_select_k.name: select_k
m07_select_k.contract: Input pairs [K, validation_silhouette]; maximize score, smallest K breaks ties.
m07_select_k.feedback: Use validation geometry and a declared tie-break, not smallest inertia.

m07_profile.name: profile
m07_profile.contract: Return string cluster IDs mapped to count and mean of a single original-unit feature.
m07_profile.feedback: Describe both support and feature level; IDs have no rank.

m09_vocabulary.name: vocabulary
m09_vocabulary.contract: Return alphabetical lowercase whitespace tokens with IDs starting at 2; 0=padding,1=unknown.
m09_vocabulary.solution:
tokens = sorted({token for text in training_texts for token in text.lower().split()})
return {word:i+2 for i,word in enumerate(tokens)}
m09_vocabulary.feedback: Fit only training text and reserve unknown/padding separately.

m09_encode.name: encode
m09_encode.contract: Lowercase/split, map unknown to 1, keep first length tokens and pad with 0.
m09_encode.solution:
ids = [vocabulary.get(token,1) for token in text.lower().split()][:length]
return ids + [0]*(length-len(ids))
m09_encode.feedback: Unknown is not padding; declare truncation direction.

m09_recall.name: recall
m09_recall.contract: Return TP/(TP+FN); None when there are no actual positives.
m09_recall.solution: return tp/(tp+fn) if tp+fn else None
m09_recall.feedback: Use actual positives, not total messages or predicted positives.

m10_parse_label.name: parse_label
m10_parse_label.contract: Return ham/spam only for an exact one-key JSON object; otherwise return None.
m10_parse_label.feedback: Reject prose and extra keys; parsing is separate from correctness.

m10_valid_fraction.name: valid_fraction
m10_valid_fraction.contract: Input parsed labels or None. Return valid/total, or None for empty input.
m10_valid_fraction.solution: return sum(x in ["ham","spam"] for x in labels)/len(labels) if labels else None
m10_valid_fraction.feedback: Count malformed outputs in the denominator.

m10_end_to_end_accuracy.name: end_to_end_accuracy
m10_end_to_end_accuracy.contract: Return exact matches / all cases, counting None as wrong; None for no cases.
m10_end_to_end_accuracy.solution: return sum(a==p for a,p in zip(actual,parsed))/len(actual) if actual else None
m10_end_to_end_accuracy.feedback: Do not condition accuracy on the outputs the parser accepted.

m11_trainable_count.name: trainable_count
m11_trainable_count.contract: Input [size, trainable] pairs; return number of trainable scalar values.
m11_trainable_count.solution: return sum(size for size,trainable in parameters if trainable)
m11_trainable_count.feedback: Count scalars in trainable tensors, not the number of tensors.

m11_completion_labels.name: completion_labels
m11_completion_labels.contract: Return ids with prompt and padding positions replaced by -100.
m11_completion_labels.solution: return [token if i>=prompt_length and attention_mask[i] else -100 for i,token in enumerate(ids)]
m11_completion_labels.feedback: Mask both prompt and padding, while retaining completion tokens.

m11_changed_tensors.name: changed_tensors
m11_changed_tensors.contract: Input equally sized lists of scalar lists. Return indices of tensors with any changed value.
m11_changed_tensors.solution: return [i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(before,after)) if a != b]
m11_changed_tensors.feedback: Demonstrate an actual parameter change; a new loss string is insufficient.

m12_valid_request.name: valid_request
m12_valid_request.contract: Return True for exactly the expected keys, finite int/float values; reject bool.
m12_valid_request.solution:
import math
return set(record)==set(expected) and all(type(record[k]) in [int,float] and math.isfinite(record[k]) for k in expected)
m12_valid_request.feedback: Booleans are not numerical measurements in this contract; reject extras.

m12_shift_score.name: shift_score
m12_shift_score.contract: Return absolute standardized difference, or None for a nonpositive training scale.
m12_shift_score.feedback: Use the fixed training scale, not a scale fitted on new requests.

m12_nearest_rank.name: nearest_rank
m12_nearest_rank.contract: Return sorted values at ceil(percentile*n)-1 for 0 < percentile <= 1.
m12_nearest_rank.feedback: Name the percentile convention and retain the tail request.

m13_recall_denominator.name: recall_denominator
m13_recall_denominator.feedback: Recall conditions on actual positives, not predictions.

m13_safe_rate.name: safe_rate
m13_safe_rate.contract: Return numerator/denominator, or None for zero denominator.
m13_safe_rate.solution: return numerator/denominator if denominator else None
m13_safe_rate.feedback: Unavailable is not evidence of parity.

m13_wilson.name: wilson
m13_wilson.contract: Return a two-number 95% illustrative Wilson interval using learning.wilson_interval.
m13_wilson.feedback: State the conditional independent-binomial assumption before interpreting the interval.

m14_route_intent.name: route_intent
m14_route_intent.contract: Return count_rows for count, mean_alcohol for alcohol; otherwise None.
m14_route_intent.feedback: An unsupported intent must not fall through to an unrelated answer.

m14_allowed_call.name: allowed_call
m14_allowed_call.contract: Allow only count_rows with no arguments, or mean_alcohol with no arguments.
m14_allowed_call.feedback: Validate tool and argument contract, not just words in a prompt.

m14_can_call.name: can_call
m14_can_call.contract: Return True for nonnegative whole-number used/budget and used < budget; reject bool.
m14_can_call.solution: return type(used) is int and type(budget) is int and 0 <= used < budget
m14_can_call.feedback: Stop before exceeding the budget and reject malformed limits.
